title_sq: Tek Shkolla E Baletit, Shitet Ambient Biznesi I Sapo Investuar !
description_sq: Tek Shkolla e Baletit prane Pasticeri Lej Laj Shitet Ambient Biznesi I Sapo Investuar. Ambienti ka siperfaqe 145 m2 dhe ndodhet ne katin e dyte te nje pallati ekzistues dhe eshte i organizuar ne 5 dhoma, 3 tualete dhe nje depo. Ambienti eshte totalisht i investuar duke filluar nga instalimet hidraulike, elektrike, punime gipsi ndricim Led, parket Ac5, sistem kondicionimi Multisplit, vetrata Treplex, veshje me fasade te ventiluar etj. title_en: At the Ballet School, Newly Invested Business Space for Sale!
description_en: Newly Invested Business Environment for Sale at the Ballet School near Lej Laj Pastry Shop. The environment has an area of ​​145 m2 and is located on the second floor of an existing building and is organized in 5 rooms, 3 toilets and a warehouse. The environment is fully invested, starting with hydraulic and electrical installations, plaster works, LED lighting, Ac5 parquet, Multisplit air conditioning system, Treplex windows, ventilated facade cladding, etc. The environment is suitable for a variety of activities such as: different offices, dental clinics, aesthetic clinics, laboratories, etc.
